summary: A written statement of 29 January 2026 reported progress on the Strategic Approach to Welsh Fisheries and Aquaculture since December 2024: a consultation on King Scallop fishery management measures closed on 31 January 2026, the Welsh Marine and Fisheries Scheme opened its sixth round on 7 January with an increased budget, 194,000 pounds went to inshore vessel monitoring systems, and multi-year science contracts and a carbon audit of the Welsh fleet were commissioned. The Wales-only Crab and Lobster Fisheries Management Plan, which the statement said would soon go to consultation, opened for consultation on 4 August 2026, with responses invited until 27 October 2026.
title: Welsh fisheries and aquaculture update reports progress on management plans and fleet decarbonisation
